SELECT a.id, a.title, a.title_image AS titleImage, a.description, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime, a.read_num AS readNum, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName FROM t_article a LEFT JOIN t_article_category_rel acr ON a.id = acr.article_id LEFT JOIN t_category c ON acr.category_id = c.id WHERE a.is_deleted = 0
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
